```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1️⃣ Préparer CSSA pour le graphique
CSSA_long_plot <- CSSA_wide_unique %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("CSS_"),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(source = "CSSA")

# 2️⃣ Préparer CSSG pour le graphique
CSSG_long_plot <- CSSG %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("CSS_"),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(source = "CSSG")

# 3️⃣ Combiner les deux datasets
combined_plot <- bind_rows(CSSA_long_plot, CSSG_long_plot)

# 4️⃣ Graphique côte à côte
ggplot(combined_plot, aes(x = variable, fill = factor(value))) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  facet_wrap(~source) +  # une facette par dataset
  labs(y = "Proportion", fill = "Valeur") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# 1️⃣ Transformation
CSSA_long <- CSSA %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -sid,
    names_to = "var",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  separate(var, into = c("visit", "variable"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  mutate(
    Visit = as.numeric(gsub("v", "", visit))
  )

# 2️⃣ Mapping des variables
mapping <- c(
  # CSS_OB
  "cssdoul" = "CSS_OB_Pain",
  "csshypall" = "CSS_OB_Hyperalgesia",
  "csstemp" = "CSS_OB_Temperature",
  "cssoed" = "CSS_OB_Oedema",
  "csseryth" = "CSS_OB_Erythema",
  "csssud" = "CSS_OB_Sudation",
  "csstroph" = "CSS_OB_Trophicity",
  "cssforcemoy" = "CSS_OB_Strength",
  # CSS_SUB
  "css2" = "CSS_SUB_Pain",
  "css3" = "CSS_SUB_Hyperalgesia",
  "css4" = "CSS_SUB_Temperature",
  "css5" = "CSS_SUB_Erythema",
  "css6" = "CSS_SUB_Sudation",
  "css7" = "CSS_SUB_Oedema",
  "css8" = "CSS_SUB_Trophicity",
  "css9" = "CSS_SUB_Strength"
)
CSSA_long <- CSSA_long %>%
  mutate(variable = recode(variable, !!!mapping))

# 3️⃣ Pivot vers format tuteur et renommer ID
CSSA_wide <- CSSA_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = variable,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  rename(ID = sid)

# 4️⃣ Mapping des patients
id_map <- c(
  "case 1" = "C01P001",
  "case 2" = "C01P002",
  "case 3" = "C01P003",
  "case 4" = "C01P005",
  "case 5" = "C01P006",
  "case 6" = "C01P007"
)
CSSA_wide <- CSSA_wide %>%
  mutate(ID = recode(ID, !!!id_map))

# 5️⃣ Supprimer doublons et réordonner les colonnes
CSSA_wide_unique <- CSSA_wide %>%
  group_by(ID, Visit) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ first(.)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  select(
    ID, Visit,
    CSS_OB_Pain, CSS_OB_Hyperalgesia, CSS_OB_Temperature, CSS_OB_Oedema, 
    CSS_OB_Erythema, CSS_OB_Sudation, CSS_OB_Trophicity, CSS_OB_Strength,
    CSS_SUB_Pain, CSS_SUB_Hyperalgesia, CSS_SUB_Temperature, CSS_SUB_Erythema,
    CSS_SUB_Sudation, CSS_SUB_Oedema, CSS_SUB_Trophicity, CSS_SUB_Strength
  )

# 6️⃣ Préparer le tableau du tuteur pour comparaison
binary_cols <- grep("^CSS_", names(CSSG), value = TRUE)

CSSG_long <- CSSG %>%
  select(ID, Visit, all_of(binary_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(ID, Visit),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "tuteur"
  )
```

```{r}
# 7️⃣ Mettre CSSA et CSSG au format long pour comparer
CSSA_long_for_comparison <- CSSA_wide_unique %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(ID, Visit),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "toi"
  )

# 8️⃣ Fusionner avec le tableau du tuteur
comparison <- CSSA_long_for_comparison %>%
  left_join(CSSG_long, by = c("ID", "Visit", "variable")) %>%
  mutate(diff = toi != tuteur)  # TRUE si différence

# 9️⃣ Extraire seulement les différences
diffs <- comparison %>%
  filter(diff == TRUE) %>%
  select(ID, Visit, variable, toi, tuteur)

# 10️⃣ Résumé rapide
n_diffs <- nrow(diffs)  # nombre total de différences
n_diffs

# 11️⃣ Aperçu des premières différences
head(diffs)

# 12️⃣ Résumé par ID et Visit : combien de variables diffèrent
summary_by_ID <- diffs %>%
  group_by(ID, Visit) %>%
  summarise(nb_diff = n(), vars_diff = paste(variable, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop")

summary_by_ID
```

```{r}
#bland Altman for V1

#création de colonnes moyennes et différences
CSSScores$V1_mean <- (CSSScores$V1_Scoreobj + CSSScores$V1_Scoresubj)/2
CSSScores$V1_diff <- CSSScores$V1_Scoreobj - CSSScores$V1_Scoresubj

# Biais et SD des différences 
mean_diff <- mean(CSSScores$V1_diff, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_diff <- sd(CSSScores$V1_diff, na.rm = TRUE)

# Limites d'accord 95%
lower_limit <- mean_diff - 1.96*sd_diff
upper_limit <- mean_diff + 1.96*sd_diff

# Plot avec ggplot
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(CSSScores, aes(x = V1_mean, y = V1_diff)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean_diff, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = lower_limit, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = upper_limit, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Bland-Altman Plot V1",
       x = "Moyenne des scores (Obj & Subj)",
       y = "Différence des scores (Obj - Subj)")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Boucle sur toutes les visites
for (v in 1:20) {
  obj_col <- paste0("V", v, "_Scoreobj")
  subj_col <- paste0("V", v, "_Scoresubj")
  mean_col <- paste0("V", v, "_mean")
  diff_col <- paste0("V", v, "_diff")
  
  # Création des colonnes moyenne et différence
  CSSScores[[mean_col]] <- (CSSScores[[obj_col]] + CSSScores[[subj_col]]) / 2
  CSSScores[[diff_col]] <- CSSScores[[obj_col]] - CSSScores[[subj_col]]
  
  # Biais et limites d'accord 95%
  mean_diff <- mean(CSSScores[[diff_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_diff <- sd(CSSScores[[diff_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  lower_limit <- mean_diff - 1.96*sd_diff
  upper_limit <- mean_diff + 1.96*sd_diff
  
  # Bland-Altman plot
  p <- ggplot(CSSScores, aes_string(x = mean_col, y = diff_col)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = mean_diff, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = lower_limit, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = upper_limit, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = paste0("Bland-Altman Plot V", v),
         x = "Moyenne des scores (Obj & Subj)",
         y = "Différence des scores (Obj - Subj)")
  
  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
#Bland Altman with all repeated mesures
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Passage en format long
data_long <- CSSScores %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -sid,
    names_to = c("Visit", "Type"),
    names_pattern = "V(\\d+)_(Scoreobj|Scoresubj)",
    values_to = "Score"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Type,
    values_from = Score
  )
#bland altman calcul
data_long <- data_long %>%
  mutate(
    mean = (Scoreobj + Scoresubj)/2,
    diff = Scoreobj - Scoresubj
  )

#biais et limites d'accord
mean_diff <- mean(data_long$diff, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_diff <- sd(data_long$diff, na.rm = TRUE)

lower_limit <- mean_diff - 1.96 * sd_diff
upper_limit <- mean_diff + 1.96 * sd_diff

# Bland-Altman plot
ggplot(data_long, aes(x = mean, y = diff, color = sid)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean_diff, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = lower_limit, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = upper_limit, linetype = "dashed") +
  
  labs(
    title = "Bland-Altman global (toutes les visites)",
    x = "Moyenne des scores (Obj & Subj)",
    y = "Différence (Obj - Subj)",
    color = "Patient"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
